reference: Forrester JW. Urban Dynamics appendix model (1974 copyright declaration), native Vensim URBAN.mdl, servermodified2024-09-04; downloaded2026-10-20. Full model equations before sketch section.
description: Exact baseline reconstruction of the original native Vensim URBAN.mdl, including all20 integrators, all auxiliary equations, all53 lookup tables, and source numeric inputs/initial equations. This is the Forrester appendix urban model, not the unrelated generated four-stock housing/jobs/infrastructure hybrid. Six GAME(0) inputs use their declared static basevalue0; interactive game interventions and external CIN files are not selected. Vensim lookup endpoint behavior is continuous interpolation with constant endpoint extension. Source initial0, final250 years and Euler step1 are restored. Compatible original Housing_Stock, Jobs and Population nodes are source-sector aggregates; Infrastructure has no native counterpart and is archived in the repair receipt. Model classes are the source's historical categories and coefficients, not a contemporary calibrated urban forecast.
